about: Route selection cases shared by backend/services/node_route.py select_route and frontend/src/lib/directRoute.ts selectRoute, against the real node catalog. paramKeys (when given) are the params that route shows and sends, sorted. wired (when given) are input ports with a value, added to params as with_wired_blockers / withWiredBlockers do before routing. block (when given) is direct_block / directBlock for those params: null, or its reason, param, and detail / on when set. Each case runs on its 'today' (YYYY-MM-DD), else on defaultToday, so date-gated routes (node_route.DIRECT_RETIRES) don't flip when the calendar does. definitions are inline route-table nodes (definition `routes`, docs/PROVIDER-ROUTES.md); a case's nodeId names one of them or a registry node. For a route-table node, expected also has routeId, block (null, or its reason, param, and detail / on when set) and missing (the keys it needs), and unavailable is route_unavailable / routeUnavailable (null when the run can start). wiredCounts (when given) maps an input port to how many inputs it carries, as filled_counts gives with_wired_blockers. shownRoute (when given) is shown_route_id / shownRouteId, whose options the node shows, and routeParams is route_param_definitions / routeParamDefinitions for it: each param's key, option values and min/max as that route offers them. routeParams also carry each param's visibleWhen as that route shows it (the param's own merged with the route's paramVisibleWhen), and sentKeys (when given) is route_sent_keys / routeSentKeys on the shown route: the params a run there sends with these values, a hidden setting never. A block with reason 'hidden' is rule H (docs/PROVIDER-ROUTES.md): a saved non-default value of a setting the route doesn't show, that another route would honor; its 'on' is that route, 'detail' the setting as the card shows it, 'when' what hides it here. unavailable.fixes are the one-click edits that let the run start where it is ([{param, value}], value null meaning clear). routes-hide is the inline node for rule H's branches.
